content.text: {"id": "mm705152a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "4,149 (97.6%) of which were not serious."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "after dose 2, a total of 17,180 (57.5%) local and 12,223 systemic (40.9%) reactions"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "after dose 2, a total of 17,180 (57.5%) local and 12,223 systemic (40.9%) reactions"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 4,149 (97.6%) VAERS reports were for nonserious events, and 100 (2.4%) were for serious events."}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Approximately 1% of parents reported seeking medical care in the week after vaccination"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "systemic reactions were more frequently reported during the week after dose 2 (12,223; 40.9%) than dose 1."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 4,149 (97.6%) VAERS reports were for nonserious events, and 100 (2.4%) were for serious events."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "VAERS is a national passive vaccine safety surveillance system, jointly managed by CDC and FDA"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "a voluntary smartphone-based active safety surveillance system, specifically to monitor adverse events"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "were analyzed and described overall and by sex, age group, and race/ethnicity."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "SAS software (version 9.4; SAS Institute) was used to conduct all analyses."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Reports of myocarditis and pericarditis after receipt of COVID-19 vaccine were identified by a search for selected MedDRA preferred terms"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "1,028 (19.5%) were excluded from this analysis because vaccination occurred before authorization for use in this age group or date of vaccination was unknown."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
